sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me try moving UP to see if the blue squares can navigate the maze
# They're currently at rows 54-57
# Let me move UP step by step and track positions

positions = []
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    blues = sorted([(n['boundary'][0][0], n['boundary'][0][1]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'S'])
    positions.append(blues)
    print(f"UP #{i+1}: blues at {blues}, changed={result.get('board_changed')}, done={result.get('done')}")
    if result.get('done'):
        break

print("\nPosition history:", positions)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
